name: Under Blue
source:
Summer. There are people who can't enjoy the blue sky because their bodies start to lose mass due to an unknown disease. Such people attend local school. Some say there is no hope for the afflicted. But two students continue to seek their own way in life.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
